usageNotes: Returns the firewall directory index for a specific QEMU VM on a PDM-managed PVE remote — use it to discover which firewall sub-resources are available (e.g., rules, aliases, ipsets, options, refs) before drilling into them. No query parameters are required and no privilege beyond basic authentication is needed. The return payload is a directory listing, not the actual firewall ruleset, so follow up with the appropriate child endpoint to read or modify firewall configuration.

examples.summary: List firewall sub-resources for VM 101 on the 'hetzner-pve1' remote

tips: The vmid path parameter must match a VM that actually exists on the target PVE remote; an invalid vmid typically returns a 404 from the proxied PVE node.
This endpoint is a directory index only — it does not return firewall rules, options, or aliases directly. Use child endpoints such as .../firewall/rules or .../firewall/options for actionable data.
The remote name must match exactly the remote identifier registered in PDM; check /pve/remotes for valid names.
